title: Beat 142 - Descent
description: A man in a black jacket and boots is captured mid-fall in a derelict concrete room, one arm raised and the other holding a glowing green device. Below him, broken stairs lead into a flooded lower level containing a film reel case labeled 'FOLLOW ALONG', while a large framed painting of a black horse in a desert leans against the steps amid scattered gold fragments.
